msg: Profile pinned to US Core 3.1.1 - that is the USCDI v1 element set. Certified health IT has had to carry USCDI v3 since 2026-01-01.
Profile pinned to US Core 5.0.1 - that is the USCDI v2 element set. USCDI v3 needs US Core 6.1.0 or above.
US Core profile claimed with no |version. Nothing in this file proves which USCDI version you meet at test time.
US Core resource type with no us-core profile in meta.profile. An unlabelled resource is not a conformance claim.
DSTU2 or STU3 artefact in an R4 resource set. US Core 6.1.0 is FHIR R4 (4.0.1) only.
Legacy hl7.org/fhir/v2 or /v3 code system URL. R4 moved these to terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem.
Patient carries no us-core-race and us-core-ethnicity extension. Race and ethnicity are required USCDI Patient Demographics elements.
Patient carries no us-core-genderIdentity extension. Gender identity is one of the elements USCDI v3 added over v2.
CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion is not 4.0.1, so the server advertises a version US Core 6.1.0 does not profile.
meta block with no lastUpdated. Surveyors cannot date the resource against the 2026-01-01 USCDI v3 line.
